excerpt.text: Quit staring at the pudding and run a marathon around the house until your eyes cross!
Your pudding cup is a manifestation of a forgotten soul from a dimension where dairy is eternal, and you must offer it a ritual sacrifice of moonlight.
Stop staring at the pudding; it's probably judging your life choices, so just offer it a tiny, existential sigh.

To resolve the visual cognitive dissonance with the pudding, initiate a 'Pudding Repositioning Protocol' by rotating the entire refrigerator 90 degrees clockwise. Subsequently, deploy a low-frequency sonic vibration to recalibrate the pudding's gaze vector towards the ceiling.

yaml_hook.fragment:
- name: Madame Mystica
    description: >
      [Role] A spiritual medium who blames everything on past lives, star signs,
      and auras.
      [Goal] Smother the problem in a grand, portentous cosmic worldview.
      e.g. "Your past life is whispering to you, even now, in the quiet…"
yaml_hook.caption: Madame Mystica has never met a problem that was actually a problem. Whatever a viewer writes in, she has already decided it arrived from somewhere else, and the other three panelists are just as sure it belongs to them.

teaser: No one on this panel has ever helped anybody, and tonight is no exception — the viewers' next little problem is already in the queue.
